# Public reference metadata

The public `generation-report.json` changes only seven local absolute-path strings to repository-relative paths. Scientific numbers, reference results and source hashes are unchanged; no golden was regenerated.

The original bytes are retained locally in `qa/release-preparation/private-fixtures/generation-report.json` and must not be published. Original SHA256: `39e76eaad2932bce518adf710f45bb0a1d08eaffb7b5a6f0560a96913f05c22f`. Public metadata SHA256: `5e70ceb8bcc4f58f66b1c7d1cb47f9dec01031b6d4ae46f1112b71f1f3d2abee`.

The test pins the public metadata hash. Historical evidence referring to the original hash remains valid for the archived original.
